report.name: OpenVAS Infrastructure Scan - VertexAI Production Enclave

result.name: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Log4Shell)
result.comment: Confirmed via active LDAP JNDI lookup callback
result.description: Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.

nvt.name: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Log4Shell)
nvt.tags: cvss_base_vector=AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H|summary=Apache Log4j is prone to a remote code execution vulnerability.|solution=Update to version 2.17.1 or later.

result.name: OpenSSL TLS Heartbeat Information Disclosure (Heartbleed)
result.description: The (1) TLS and (2) DTLS implementations in OpenSSL 1.0.1 before 1.0.1g do not properly handle Heartbeat Extension packets, allowing remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory.

result.name: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 Path Traversal and RCE
result.comment: Path traversal probe confirmed file read
result.description: An issue was found in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path normalization logic allowing unauthenticated path traversal and potential remote code execution.

nvt.name: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 Path Traversal
nvt.tags: solution=Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later.

result.name: TCP Timestamps Supported (Informational)
result.description: The remote host implements TCP timestamps which allows computation of system uptime.
